translations.b0320: Part 11  Improving the Population Development Strategy and Promoting High-Quality Population Development
translations.b0321: With the focus on addressing population aging and the declining birth rate, the population development strategy will be improved; a population service system covering the entire population and the whole life cycle will be refined; the population structure will be optimized; the quality of the population will be raised; and high-quality population development will underpin Chinese modernization.
translations.b0323: Birth support policies and incentive measures will be improved, the costs of childbearing, child-rearing and education for families will be effectively reduced, efforts will be made to stabilize the number of new births, and long-term balanced population development will be promoted.
translations.b0325: A birth-friendly policy orientation will be maintained, and birth support will be integrated into all economic and social development policies. Full play will be given to the role of childcare subsidies and the special additional individual income tax deductions for infant and toddler care and children's education, and a mechanism for dynamically adjusting subsidy standards will be explored. Coverage of the maternity insurance system will be expanded; the level of medical expense protection for prenatal checkups will be reasonably raised; hospital delivery within the scope of policy will basically require no personal payment; and appropriate labor analgesia services will be included in the scope of protection. The maternity leave system will be fully implemented, and employers will be encouraged to adopt flexible working arrangements for employees who are parents of children under three. Fertility protection will be strengthened; an initiative to care for early pregnancy and a plan to improve capacity for preventing and treating birth defects will be implemented; and infant mortality and maternal mortality will be reduced to below 3.5 per 1,000 and 12 per 100,000, respectively. The well-regulated and orderly application of assisted reproductive technology will be advanced, and medical expense protection will be strengthened. Ways to provide subsidies for infants and young children to participate in basic medical insurance will be explored.
translations.b0326: Section 2  Improving the Childcare Service System
translations.b0327: The development of a system of affordable childcare services will be accelerated, and the supply of service resources will be expanded through multiple channels. The supply of publicly run childcare places will be increased; kindergartens will be supported in developing integrated childcare and preschool services and encouraged to enroll children aged 2–3; and non-governmental actors will be supported in providing diversified affordable childcare services through such models as employer-run childcare, community-embedded childcare and home-based childcare points. Pilot demonstrations of childcare service subsidies will be carried out in depth, and the pricing mechanism for affordable childcare services will be improved. An initiative to improve the quality of childcare services will be implemented, and the safety and standardization of childcare services will be enhanced. Legislation on childcare services will be accelerated.
translations.b0328: Section 3  Improving Family Development Policies and the Birth-Friendly Environment
translations.b0329: The policy system supporting family development will be improved, and marriage and childbearing at the appropriate age, healthy childbearing and child-rearing, and the sharing of child-rearing responsibilities by husband and wife will be encouraged. A new culture of marriage and childbearing will be cultivated, a positive outlook on marriage and childbearing will be advocated, and outdated practices in weddings and funerals will be effectively addressed. Siblings in families with multiple children will be supported in attending the same school, and housing security and home-purchase policies will be tilted toward families with multiple children. Public spaces will be made more child-friendly, and maternal and infant facilities will be provided. The Family Education Promotion Law will be implemented; community parents' schools and similar institutions will play their role; and guidance services for family education will be strengthened. The system of comprehensive assistance and support for families with special difficulties under the family planning policy will be improved. Comprehensive efforts to address the sex ratio at birth will be strengthened. The population monitoring system and the forecasting and early-warning system will be improved.
translations.b0330: Chapter 38  Running Education That Satisfies the People
translations.b0331: Priority will be given to the development of education; the fundamental task of fostering virtue through education will be carried out; comprehensive reform of education will be deepened; mechanisms for allocating educational resources suited to demographic changes will be improved; a high-quality education system will be built; and socialist builders and successors who are well developed morally, intellectually, physically, aesthetically and through labor will be cultivated.
translations.b0332: Section 1  Implementing the New-Era Project for Fostering Virtue Through Education
translations.b0333: Unremitting efforts will be made to use Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era to forge the soul and educate the people; the development of “great ideological and political courses” will be strengthened; the curriculum and textbook system will be improved; the curriculum plan for ideological and political courses in higher education institutions in the new era will be fully implemented; quality-oriented education will be carried out in depth; and students will be helped to grow up healthily and develop in an all-round way. Forms of practical education will be innovated; dedicated courses on social practice for university students will be developed; a system of study tours on national conditions for primary and secondary school students will be established; and ideological and political classes will be effectively integrated with social practice. A plan to strengthen students' physical fitness will be implemented; aesthetic education immersion initiatives and programs to cultivate good labor habits will be carried out; and mental health education will be made universal. The student financial assistance system covering all stages of education will be improved. An initiative to popularize the standard spoken and written Chinese language and raise its quality will be implemented. The spirit of educators will be carried forward; the professional ethics of teachers will be strengthened; teachers' salaries and benefits will be safeguarded; a project to enhance teacher education capacity will be implemented; and a high-level teaching workforce will be cultivated. Mechanisms for coordinated education by schools, families and society will be improved. Reform of educational evaluation will be deepened, and differentiated management and evaluation mechanisms will be established. Private education will be guided toward well-regulated development.
translations.b0334: Section 2  Expanding Quality Basic Education and Raising Its Standards
translations.b0335: Dynamic adjustments and reallocation of basic education resources across different stages of schooling will be strengthened, and the supply of educational resources will be expanded in towns and cities experiencing net inflows of school-age population. The provision of high-quality, balanced compulsory education will be advanced; school principals and teachers will be better coordinated, allocated and rotated within their regions; small-class teaching will be advanced in an orderly manner; and necessary small rural schools will be run well. The provision of high-quality, affordable preschool education will be advanced; the proportion of places in public kindergartens will be increased; and the gross enrollment rate in preschool education will rise to 95 percent. Resources for regular high schools will be expanded; the plan to revitalize county-level regular high schools will be implemented in depth; and the completion rate of senior secondary education will reach 88 percent. The scope of free education will be steadily expanded, and extending the number of years of compulsory education will be explored. Reform of the high school entrance examination will be advanced in an orderly manner; the proportion of enrollment quotas for high-quality high schools allocated to individual schools will be increased; and areas where conditions permit will be supported in piloting balanced allocation of enrollment placements. The “double reduction” policy and improvements in the quality of education and teaching will be advanced in a coordinated way. Support mechanisms for special education and specialized education will be improved.
translations.b0336: Section 3  Improving the Quality and Expanding the Capacity of Higher Education
translations.b0337: In line with their basic positioning as research-oriented, application-oriented or skills-oriented institutions, higher education institutions will be reformed and developed on a categorized basis. Enrollment in high-quality undergraduate programs and in postgraduate education will be expanded in an orderly manner, mainly in science, engineering, agriculture and medical programs; the gross enrollment rate in higher education will reach 65 percent; and the proportion of undergraduate enrollment and the share of postgraduate students among all higher education students will be steadily increased. Professional degree postgraduate education will be vigorously developed, and the proportion of master's and doctoral students in engineering will be increased. High-quality higher education resources will be expanded through multiple channels; greater efforts will be made to build high-level research universities; and application-oriented undergraduate institutions will be strengthened. Newly added higher education resources will be appropriately tilted toward populous provinces and the central and western regions. Adjustments to the per capita education funding standard for undergraduate students will be studied and made in due course, and basic conditions such as student dormitories will be continuously improved. The opening-up of high-level education will be expanded; high-level foreign science and engineering universities will be encouraged to establish cooperative programs in China; and the brand and capacity building of “Study in China” will be strengthened. The education digitalization strategy will be implemented in depth. Public services for lifelong learning will be improved, and the system of the Open University of China will be improved.
translations.b0338: Section 4  Enhancing the Capacity of Vocational Schools
translations.b0339: The development of a modern vocational education system will be advanced, and the quality and attractiveness of vocational education will be improved. The layout of vocational education will be optimized to align with regional development and industrial distribution, and the setting of majors will be closely matched to the needs of industrial and innovation chains. Reform of secondary vocational education will be deepened; a small number of excellent secondary vocational schools will be run well; distinctive high-quality higher vocational schools will be built; and the integrated development of secondary and higher vocational education will be supported. A number of high-level vocational schools at the undergraduate level will be built, and the integration of undergraduate vocational education with professional degree education will be promoted. A talent cultivation model integrating industry and education will be adopted; education mechanisms that combine moral cultivation with skills training and integrate learning with work will be improved; and leading enterprises in industries will be encouraged to run or participate in running vocational schools.
translations.b0340: Chapter 39  Accelerating the Building of a Healthy China
translations.b0341: A strategy of giving priority to health in development will be implemented; the policy and institutional systems for health promotion will be improved; the patriotic health campaign will be made more effective; the shift from a treatment-centered approach to a health-centered approach will be promoted; fair, accessible, systematic and continuous health services will be provided to the people; and the people's health will be improved.
translations.b0342: Section 1  Improving the Public Health System
translations.b0343: Public health capacity will be strengthened; social co-governance, coordination between medical treatment and disease prevention, and integration of the two will be deepened; and systems for infectious disease prevention and control, emergency response, medical treatment, supplies support and oversight will be established and improved. The disease control system will be strengthened; capacity for infectious disease surveillance, early warning and epidemiological investigation will be enhanced; the public health laboratory network will be improved; and a tiered, classified and triaged treatment system will be developed. Prevention and control of major infectious diseases will be strengthened, and mechanisms for joint prevention and control will be improved. The types of vaccines in the national immunization program will be dynamically optimized. The emergency medical rescue and pre-hospital first aid systems will be improved, and blood supply and emergency response capacity will be enhanced. Mental health and psychological services will be strengthened, and early detection and comprehensive intervention for common mental disorders and psychological problems among key groups will be enhanced. Prevention and treatment of occupational diseases will be strengthened. A balanced diet initiative and the national nutrition program will be implemented, and action to promote healthy weight management will be continued.
translations.b0344: Section 2  Building a High-Quality and Efficient Medical Service System
translations.b0345: The functional positioning and distribution of medical institutions will be optimized, and the hierarchical diagnosis and treatment system will be improved. The expansion and downward transfer of high-quality medical resources and their balanced regional distribution will be promoted; the building of national medical centers will be advanced steadily and in an orderly manner; and national regional medical centers will be improved in quality and efficiency. A project to strengthen the foundations of medical and health services will be implemented; the operation of county, district and grassroots medical institutions will be better supported; full coverage of county-level medical communities will be basically achieved, with closer coordination and synergy; the building of tight urban medical groups will be advanced; the mobile medical service system will be improved; the coverage of and satisfaction with family doctor services will be increased; and the share of diagnoses and treatments handled by grassroots medical and health institutions will be raised, with a reasonable increase in the variety of medicines stocked. Comprehensive prevention and control of chronic diseases will be strengthened; services covering prevention, treatment, rehabilitation and management across the whole chain will be developed; a system for early screening, early diagnosis and early treatment will be improved; and the premature mortality rate from major chronic diseases will be reduced to below 13 percent. The supply of rehabilitation, nursing and hospice care services will be expanded, and a project to expand and upgrade rehabilitation and nursing services will be implemented. The ranks of general practitioners, licensed physicians and nurses will be strengthened, and standardized residency training will be improved. The digital and intelligent development of health services for all will be advanced, and the mutual recognition and sharing of test and examination results will be promoted.
translations.b0346: Section 3  Improving the Mechanism for Coordinated Development and Governance of Medical Services, Medical Insurance and Medicines
translations.b0347: Reform of the medical and health system will be deepened to promote unified goals, policy coordination, information connectivity and coordinated oversight. Public hospital reform will be deepened with a focus on public welfare; a mechanism for dynamically adjusting the staffing of public hospitals will be established; a charging mechanism centered on medical services will be improved; the remuneration system will be refined; the practice of medical institutions and medical personnel will be regulated; and legal safeguards in the medical and health field will be strengthened. The development of private hospitals will be guided toward well-regulated operation. Reform of medical insurance payment methods will be deepened; the use of surplus funds will be optimized; differentiated payment policies for medical institutions at different levels will be improved; the personal cost burden of insured persons will be reduced; and the efficiency of medical insurance fund use will be increased. The medicine pricing mechanism will be improved, and the policy for centralized procurement of medicines and medical consumables will be refined. Review and approval of innovative drugs and drugs in urgent clinical need will be optimized; mechanisms for medical insurance to support the high-quality development of innovative drugs and medical devices will be improved; the catalog of innovative drugs will be refined; and commercial insurance will be encouraged to expand coverage for innovative drugs.
translations.b0348: Section 4  Promoting the Inheritance and Innovation of Traditional Chinese Medicine
translations.b0349: The revitalization and development of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) will be promoted, and the integration of TCM and Western medicine will be advanced. The TCM service system will be improved; primary-level TCM service capacity will be enhanced; specialized TCM departments with distinctive strengths will be developed; and coordinated TCM and Western medicine services will be developed. Scientific and technological innovation in TCM will be promoted, and a project to train TCM specialists will be implemented. The protection and utilization of TCM resources and the development of production bases for genuine regional medicinal materials will be strengthened; the development and transformation of TCM preparations and classic formulas will be enhanced; the quality of TCM will be improved; and the TCM industry will be made larger and stronger. Reform of medical insurance payment methods suited to the characteristics of TCM will be advanced. TCM culture will be promoted, and TCM will be taken global.
translations.b0350: Section 5  Accelerating the Building of a Leading Country in Sports
translations.b0351: Mass sports will be actively developed; nationwide fitness activities will be carried out extensively; fitness among young people will be promoted; and the proportion of people who regularly participate in physical exercise will reach around 40 percent. The public service system for nationwide fitness will be improved, and the layout and construction of sports facilities near people's homes will be strengthened. The management system and operating mechanisms of competitive sports will be reformed and improved; the training of reserve talent and R&D on sports science and technology equipment will be strengthened; and the overall strength of competitive sports will be enhanced. High-quality preparations will be made for major international competitions, and the National Games will be well organized. The revitalization and development of the “three major ball games” will be advanced, and reform in football will be deepened. The supply of high-quality sports products and services will be enriched; the development of the sports event economy will be encouraged; waters, airspace and mountains will be opened up for outdoor sports in a safe and orderly manner; the achievements of “engaging 300 million people in winter sports” will be consolidated and expanded; and the high-quality development of the sports industry will be promoted.
translations.b0352: Chapter 40  Actively Responding to Population Aging
translations.b0353: The national strategy for actively responding to population aging will be implemented in depth; policy mechanisms for the coordinated development of elderly care programs and industries will be improved; and older people will be enabled to live in security, remain active and enjoy their later years.
translations.b0354: Section 1  Improving the Urban and Rural Elderly Care Service Network
translations.b0355: The layout of elderly care facilities will be planned in a coordinated manner; the supply of basic elderly care services will be optimized; and elderly care services will be expanded, improved in quality and made more efficient. Reform and development of elderly care services will be deepened, and the categorized reform of elderly care institutions will be advanced in an orderly manner. Community-embedded elderly care services will be developed, and professional, branded and chain-operated community elderly care institutions will be cultivated. Home-based elderly care beds will be developed, and age-friendly modifications of homes will be advanced. Mutual-aid elderly care services will be developed. The care system for older people who are disabled or living with dementia will be improved; the supply of nursing-type beds in elderly care institutions will be increased; and the integration of medical care and elderly care will be actively advanced. Long-term care insurance will be introduced, and a unified assessment system for the capabilities of older people will be improved. The professionalization of the elderly care workforce will be advanced, and the quality and effectiveness of comprehensive oversight of elderly care services will be enhanced. Care and assistance for older people living alone at advanced ages and for empty-nest older people will be strengthened.
translations.b0356: Section 2  Creating a Rich and Colorful Life in Old Age
translations.b0357: A positive outlook on aging and healthy aging will be integrated into the whole process of economic and social development; education on population aging as a national condition will be carried out in depth; and a social environment of filial piety and respect for older people will be fostered. The silver economy will be vigorously developed; the supply of age-friendly products and services for older people will be enriched; leading enterprises and well-known brands in the silver economy will be cultivated; a certification system for silver economy products will be explored and established; and statistics on the silver economy will be improved. The human resources of older people will be actively developed; the progressive raising of the statutory retirement age will be implemented prudently; age restrictions in employment, social security and other areas will be optimized; diverse jobs suitable for older people will be expanded; and the “Silver Age Action” will be carried out in depth. The supply of educational resources for older people will be expanded, and universities for older people will be developed to meet their intellectual and cultural needs. Preferential treatment and protection of the rights and interests of older people will be strengthened. Public facilities will be made more age-friendly; the “smart technology for older people” initiative will be continued; high-frequency services for older people will be made easier to access and service settings simpler and more user-friendly; and integrated services for older people will be developed.
